Solution 1 is wrong. Any 2-coloring of $K_{24}$ with no blue $K_4$ and no red $K_5$ avoids both a red $K_5$ and a blue $K_5 - e$, since $K_5 - e$ contains $K_4$. Because $R(5,4) = 25$, this gives $R(K_5, K_5 - e) \geq 25$, which rules out 22. Solution 1's claimed value $R(K_4, K_5 - e) = 16$ is also not a value I can confirm.

Solutions 2 and 3 cannot be verified. Solution 2's lower-bound formula is not a standard result and its "explicit construction" and upper-bound argument are asserted without detail. Solution 3 cites $R(K_4, K_5 - e) = 22$ and $R(K_4, K_5) = 25$ without support, and its final value of 34 comes with only a reference to unspecified computer verification. I cannot confirm either 30 or 34 as the exact value. The only bounds I can establish are $25 \leq R(K_5, K_5 - e) \leq R(5,5) \leq 46$, so I have no basis to pick either of them.

CHOICE: NONE
